purpose: Dataset sources and permitted-use notes; this manifest does not imply all third-party corpora are redistributed in this ZIP.

synthetic_demo_cases.notes: Contains invented examples and reserved .invalid domains. Not representative enough to train or benchmark a model.

datasets.name: UCI SMS Spam Collection
datasets.caveat: Older English SMS dataset; does not represent modern multilingual UPI, crypto, delivery or business-email scams without fresh evaluation.

datasets.name: zefang-liu/phishing-email-dataset
datasets.license: LGPL-3.0 as listed on dataset card; verify source/card terms before redistribution or commercial use
datasets.caveat: Inspect class labels, duplicates, source quality and privacy before training.

datasets.name: PhiUSIIL phishing URL dataset (candidate) + licensed reputation feeds
datasets.license: Confirm licensing and commercial redistribution rights from the source before downloading
datasets.download_command: Not automated; verify licensing before use
datasets.caveat: Datasets can contain stale labels and source leakage. Combine temporal splits, current benign domains and reputation checks.

datasets.name: Elastic EMBER 2018 feature benchmark
datasets.license: Review upstream repository and dataset terms before use
datasets.caveat: Large feature archive; not a bundle of executable malware. Feature extraction/version compatibility matters; do not infer coverage of PDFs, Android APKs, scripts or macros.

datasets.name: No standalone QR training corpus bundled
datasets.source: Decoded QR payloads are analyzed through URL/email/payment risk modules
datasets.caveat: QR is a transport/encoding format, not a single semantic label. Build a separately licensed QR image dataset only if image-level visual classification is required.

datasets.name: ProtectAI DeBERTa v3 prompt-injection classifier
datasets.caveat: English-focused model with known false positives and limitations; use deterministic tool permissions and human approvals regardless.

recommended_models.limitations: English SMS model trained/evaluated on UCI SMS Spam Collection; small old corpus, evaluation-split selection caveat, not a production anti-fraud guarantee.

recommended_models.labels: Inspect config.json and model card before enabling; generic labels are intentionally not guessed.
recommended_models.limitations: English text classifier; this project has not independently validated its current performance. Confirm label mapping and class definition.

recommended_models.labels: Inspect model config before enabling; generic labels are intentionally not guessed.
recommended_models.limitations: Model card reports 97.17% accuracy on its evaluation set, but OmniShield has not independently reproduced that result. May be large/slow on CPU and may not generalize to new domains or regional scams.

recommended_models.labels: The model card documents class 0=benign and class 1=injection; default environment maps these to SAFE,INJECTION.
recommended_models.limitations: English-focused; card says jailbreaks/non-English prompts are not handled and false positives can occur. Enforce tool permissions and human approval independently.

recommended_models.model_license: Review current model card before use.
recommended_models.labels: Token-level NER tags are aggregated by the local pipeline.
recommended_models.limitations: Optional and local-only. It supplements deterministic secret/PII patterns and is not a complete detector for financial secrets or all PII.

not_bundled_or_no_standalone_model.reason: No generic pretrained model is bundled because invoice fraud depends on organization-specific vendors, bank-change patterns and labeled review outcomes. Current logic compares against a synthetic vendor register; custom model path is opt-in and must be independently trained/evaluated.

No universal generic deep-learning model or malware binaries are included. The API computes SHA-256 and supports ClamAV and a private inference endpoint; the latter must be supplied and secured by the operator.
QR is an encoding carrier. The API decodes image payloads and analyzes embedded URLs/payment URIs; it does not claim a standalone visual neural classifier.
